title: German group reproducing the effect

tellings.quote:
>> There's another group I'm working with
in Germany who's reproducing this. So,

plain: A group in Germany is said to be reproducing a propulsion effect that a NASA scientist named Charles Buhler says his own team has achieved, thrust described in the episode as antigravity propulsion. Buhler says it himself: "There's another group I'm working with in Germany who's reproducing this." If so, the effect would not rest on his lab's results alone.
